resources.string: Torch works under 15% — real battery stays real
Waiting for the module to report in from SystemUI
Was active last time — reopen after a SystemUI restart
Enable TorchUnlock for SystemUI in LSPosed, then restart SystemUI (or the phone)
Only inside the flashlight tile\'s own tap handler, the battery reads 100%. The status bar, quick-settings battery and every other app keep the real percentage.
The ROM listener that force-switches the torch off when the battery crosses under 15% is disabled.
v2 hooks only the flashlight tile classes. No generic battery API is touched, so the battery display cannot be affected.
SETUP — WHAT TO TICK IN LSPOSED
5. Open this app → status must go green
Step 3 is the one everyone misses. Ticking the module without ticking System UI does nothing.

Let the battery drop below 15%% and tap the flashlight tile in quick settings — it should light up, and the battery percentage must stay the real one.

If it does not, run this in Termux and send me the output:

logcat -s TorchUnlock

1. Open LSPosed → Modules
2. Tick TorchUnlock
3. Scroll down and tick SystemUI
4. Restart SystemUI or reboot the phone

That's it — the tile will work at 0%% battery, and the real percentage keeps showing.
Removes the low-battery flashlight block in SystemUI only. The real battery percentage is never touched.
